dct_description_sm: Armenia administrative level 0-1 edge-matched gazetteer, shapefiles, geodatabase, and geoservice. These boundaries are suitable for database or GIS linkage to the [Armenia - Subnational Population Statistics](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ps-arm) tables using the ADM0, ADM1, and ADM2_PCODE fields. COD-EM datasets do not replace the authoritative [COD-AB available here](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-arm); however COD-EM datasets may be preferred for cartographic purposes. See caveats. Vetting by [Information Technology Outreach Services (ITOS)](https://www.uga.edu/) with funding from USAID.
dct_publisher_sm: Government of Armenia (various agencies - see metadata)
